name: Nishi-Chugoku Sanchi Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the western Chugoku mountains on the Shimane-Hiroshima-Yamaguchi border, with Mt. Osorakan and the cedar valleys of the region.
notes: Managed by Shimane/Hiroshima/Yamaguchi. The Osorakan summit and the valley trails are the hikes.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
